headline: Margins jump on tariff refunds, direct sales lag
summary_short: Levi Strauss's Q3 2026 revenue rose 4.3% y/y to $1,610M (5% organic), with gross margin up 450bp to 66.2% as tariff refunds helped; continuing-ops diluted EPS was $0.43 and the company raised FY2026 EPS guidance.
summary_long: Net revenues grew 4% reported and 5% organic, led by Asia (+10% organic) and wholesale (+6%); direct-to-consumer rose 2% and fell short of internal expectations, with U.S. sales down 1%. Tariff refunds added 490bp to gross margin, of which about 120bp was redeployed into the business. Operating margin was 13.8% versus 10.8% a year ago. The company raised FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $1.54-$1.56 and plans a $100M accelerated share repurchase. Cash was $641M.

drivers.explanation: CEO Gass cited strong international and wholesale growth but said direct-to-consumer missed internal expectations; the CFO said most of the tariff refund benefit is being redeployed into the business in Q3 and Q4.
Growth was led by Asia (+10% organic) and wholesale (+6%); DTC grew 2% and the U.S. fell 1% on a reported basis. Beyond Yoga rose 9%.
Gross margin expanded 450bp to 66.2%; tariff refunds contributed 490bp, of which about 120bp was redeployed to support the business.
Tariff refunds contributed 490bp of margin expansion, about 160bp of which was redeployed; SG&A rose to $836M from $776M, mainly selling and distribution costs.
Net income from continuing operations rose to $169M from $122M; the effective tax rate was 23.4% versus 21.9% a year ago.
Tariff refunds contributed $0.16 of EPS benefit, of which about $0.05 was redeployed, a net benefit of $0.11.

confidence_notes: Source: EX-99.1 of the 8-K filed 2026-10-07 (items 2.02/9.01), found via the EDGAR filings list because the shard sourceLink was a Yahoo fallback. The release reports continuing operations (Dockers is in discontinued operations): diluted EPS of $0.43 vs $0.31 a year ago. The shard's SEC y/y EPS prior of $0.55 is the as-originally-reported figure including Dockers, so the EPS and net income deltas here use the release's continuing-ops prior-year figures. Adjusted diluted EPS of $0.48 is a non-GAAP measure. Tariff refunds (IEEPA) are a one-time benefit.
